data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) in the qwen model when attempting to audit .SRCINFO, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited all files, including .SRCINFO, and found no issues.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent a single file's audit failure from forcing an overall 'inconclusive' package verdict.
Distinguish between genuine security inconclusiveness and tool/infrastructure failures when determining the final package verdict.
